actions.name: flying sword
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see the sword, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 feet and either make one attack against a target or return to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies. Foundry Note Enchant the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} greatsword using the activity on this feature, granting it a "Command Sword" activity that can be used as a bonus action.

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The solar's spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]]{detect evil and good}, [[/item .1N8dDMMgZ1h1YJ3B]]{invisibility} (self only) 3/day each: [[/item .dLJhxDfeyOsc3zsY]]{blade barrier}, [[/item .TkJ8Wtg1L7TZtspm]]{dispel evil and good}, [[/item .jhhT9PsHy5A7EojO]]{resurrection} 1/day each: [[/item .d54VDyFulD9xxY7J]]{commune}, [[/item .ZPd73HtKF3At11jh]]{control weather}

actions.name: slaying longbow
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature that has 100 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or die.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=ceqRWRMK1a37epib]] to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: searing burst
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=QE8HFlW0jsWaWwdx]] must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: blinding gaze
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets [[lookup @labels.description.affects activity=fOKbYw2p3tXhOyn2]] it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=fOKbYw2p3tXhOyn2]] of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be &Reference[blinded apply=false] until magic such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.F0GsG0SJzsIOacwV]{Lesser Restoration} spell removes the blindness.

actions.name: divine awareness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows if it hears a lie.

actions.name: angelic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: healing touch
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches another creature. The target magically regains [[/heal average]] and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, &reference[blinded apply=false]{Blindness}, or &reference[deafened apply=false]{Deafness}.
